products.name: Retinol
products.description: Vitamin A (retinol) powder for cosmetic formulating. Supports the look of smoother texture and refined tone with regular leave-on use. Oil-soluble; light- and air-sensitive. Store cool, dry, and sealed. For cosmetic / personal use only — follow label guidance and use daytime SPF.

specs.Storage: Cool, dry, sealed, protect from light

products.name: Niacinamide
products.description: Vitamin B3 (niacinamide / nicotinamide) powder. A versatile water-soluble active used for barrier support and the look of more even tone, calmer skin, and refined pores. Easy to dissolve in aqueous serums and gels.

products.name: Hyaluronic Acid (Low Molecular Weight)
products.description: Low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid / sodium hyaluronate powder. A humectant that binds water for a hydrated, plump look. Highly water-soluble; forms a thinner solution than high-MW grades. Keep sealed to avoid moisture pickup.

products.name: Collagen Tripeptide (CTP)
products.description: Collagen tripeptide powder (CTP) — short glycine–proline–hydroxyproline fragments used in cosmetics for the look of firmness and hydration support. Generally water-soluble; add in cool-down when possible. Cosmetic / personal use only.

specs.INCI: Collagen Tripeptide / Hydrolyzed Collagen (verify batch COA)

products.name: EGF Powder
products.description: EGF-class cosmetic powder (typically sh-Oligopeptide-1 / recombinant epidermal growth factor analog). Marketed for the look of renewal and repair in leave-on formulas. Water-soluble but heat- and pH-sensitive — add below ~40°C. Confirm identity and purity with your batch COA. Cosmetic / personal use only.

products.name: Acetyl Hexapeptide-38
products.description: Acetyl Hexapeptide-38 powder (often known as Adifyline®). A water-soluble hexapeptide used in cosmetics for a plumper, fuller look that can soften the appearance of lines. Freely dissolves in the water phase; typically add in cool-down. Cosmetic / personal use only.
